label: United Arab Emirates (and broadly the GCC)
notes: Visa status is screened before anything else. Render work_authorization high in the document, with kind, status, expiry and - for a residence visa - transferable, which answers the NOC question a recruiter would otherwise have to ask.
Nationality is required because employment here is visa-quota driven. This is a documented market convention, not an endorsement of it.
Passport with expiry, and a UAE driving licence where held, are conventional. They live in identity_documents and stay private unless this profile is active.
Arabic proficiency is a differentiator worth stating even at a low level. Use the modality split.
Degrees are frequently required to be MOFA-attested. Record it in credentials[].attestation so the resume can say so rather than leaving a recruiter to ask.
Notice period and expected compensation in AED are routinely stated; omitting them invites a screening call that a line of text would have answered.
